rule: Test Lead waivers of NOT_BUILT or REVIEW_REQUIRED items. A waiver is never a PASS: its items report WAIVED and keep `green` false. It never covers a FAIL. It applies only while its `stage` is this file's `active_stage`, for the named challenge, items and levels; moving `active_stage` on (a committed Test Lead edit) ends every waiver of the old stage, so nothing carries over to the next stage.

waivers.scope: stage A is measurement only: no promotion, frontier or improvement claims; single-seed results are measurements. Expires at the end of stage A; stage B needs its own decision
